data: Which of these books has a higher R-squared value for its node degree distribution?

To determine which book has a higher R-squared value for its node degree distribution, I will compare the R-squared values provided in the figure captions.

For the left subfigure (a), the R-squared value is 0.9352.
For the right subfigure (b), the R-squared value is 0.9593.

Since 0.9593 is greater than 0.9352, the book represented by the right subfigure (b) has a higher R-squared value for its node degree distribution.
